ns2:course.label: Hospitality Purchasing
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the principles and procedures for the purchasing, selection and procurement of food and non-food items in the hospitality industry. Field Trips. Prerequisite: FSHN 131.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing. Restricted to BS:F Sci&Hm Nutr-Diettcs -UIUC, BS:FSci&Hm Nutr-Hosp Mgt -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, or PHD:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC.
